brief:
Pro-Palestinian demonstrations took place globally to commemorate one year since the Gaza ceasefire began, Al Jazeera English reported. The protests marked the anniversary of a halt to fighting that had drawn international attention and sparked sustained activism across multiple continents.

The commemorative events were held in cities worldwide as activist communities marked the passage of a year since the ceasefire agreement took effect.
dek: Pro-Palestinian demonstrations have been held worldwide to mark one year since the so-called Gaza ‘ceasefire'.
title: Pro-Palestinian protesters worldwide mark year since Gaza truce
